source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 29 April 1936, p. 3 ("Magherafelt Rural Council")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Belfast Telegraph 29 April 1936 p3 'Magherafelt Rural Council', read in the page image: the returning officer received nominations on Tuesday (28 April 1936) 'when the following persons were duly elected'; all twenty-six divisions named with labels.

note: Triennial election of Magherafelt Rural District Council (26 divisions). No division was contested: at the nominations on Tuesday 28 April 1936 the returning officer, Mr. J. A. Higgins, declared all twenty-six 'duly elected'. 'The Nationalists have lost three seats to the Labour Party. The new Council has again a Unionist majority.' Filed under 2 June 1936, the polling day in Co. Londonderry (confirmed in the calendar). Added in the meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026. Returned unopposed.
